turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I have not told Tom about the stair thoughts because I am afraid he will think I am dangerous.
What went through your mind then?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. It is not easy to talk about.
What happened next?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
What went through your mind then?
Before maternity leave I was a primary school teacher and I loved my class.
Tell me more about that.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I think so, yes.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I wish my mum lived closer, I feel so alone in the afternoons.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. Yes, it was like that.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I have an awful thought that I will drop Oliver down the stairs, and it comes out of nowhere.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. Yes, it was like that.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
